question.text: If a portfolio has only a RISK-FREE asset and no risky assets, portfolio standard deviation is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Risk-free asset by definition has σ = 0. Portfolio of only risk-free has σ = 0. The Trap: Students conflate expected return (> 0) with standard deviation (= 0). Cross-Exam Context: CAPM/CML groundwork. Manager's Pro-Tip: T-bills and high-quality G-Sec are used as proxies for risk-free — they still have term-structure risk in practice.
